blocks.h: My Hijrah timeline: Makkah to Madinah

questions.q: What did the second pledge add?
options: A promise to protect the Prophet ﷺ
questions.a: A) A promise to protect the Prophet ﷺ. The second pledge promised protection, preparing for the Hijrah.

questions.q: What is the rate of zakah on savings?
When must zakat al-fitr be given?
questions.a: A) Before the Eid prayer. It is given before people go out to the Eid prayer (Bukhari and Muslim).

questions.q: Who slept in the Prophet's ﷺ bed?
questions.a: A) Ali. Ali stayed behind; Abu Bakr travelled with the Prophet ﷺ.

questions.q: Where was the first masjid in Islam built?
questions.a: A) Quba. Quba, just before reaching Madinah.

options: Anyone can give it, any time
questions.a: A) Anyone can give it, any time. Sadaqah is voluntary and can be any good deed.
